card.name: Linking words before dementia and agitation
card.fires_on: The small words "with" and "in" right after "agitation", "associated" or a patient group, just before a psychiatric condition such as dementia, schizophrenia or autistic disorder. It is strongest in brexpiprazole-style label headings and trial text.

modes.description: The word "with" after "agitation associated" or "irritability associated", before dementia or autism.
